hook.name: CornersHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Corners token pools that sets configurable static LP fees per swap direction (corners vs. paired token), collects a 20% protocol fee on the non-corners token side of each swap using BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and optionally runs an MEV protection module for the first 2 minutes after pool creation.
